name: Caterpillar - Winston-Salem NC Axle Plant
type: Manufacturing plant (axles, ~850k sq ft on 102 acres)

fieldNotes.location: Roster lat/lng (ROOFTOP, movedMeters 63) landed directly on the plant building - accurate. Confirmed via Gray Construction / Dun & Bradstreet (4770 Axle Dr) and Caterpillar's own description: 850,000 sq ft axle-machining/assembly/test/paint plant on a 102-acre site, opened 2011, produces axle assemblies for the largest Cat mining trucks.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled entrance: a private access road runs from the public road (Axle Dr) past a CATERPILLAR monument sign to a gatehouse/booth structure where the road forks into the operational area (36.0618,-80.1178). Confirmed in z21 satellite and 2026 Street View.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small gatehouse building sits at the entrance road fork; a separate larger building W of it is the electrical substation. The gatehouse functions as the guard/security checkpoint - guardShack true.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Manufacturing plant (not a DC), so a modest dock count. Dock doors with trailers backed in are visible on the N and NE building faces; estimated ~14 doors, 10-25 band - flagged.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers parked along the N face and W face; extensive outdoor laydown of axle components (pallets/stacks) on the N apron. Trailer-equivalent area 10-25.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~96 acres from the perimeter box; the parcel is reported as 102 acres.
